final:
longest(take a: List[int], take b: List[int]) -> List[int] =
  post out.len() >= 0
  ex longest([1, 2], [3]) == [1, 2]
  ex longest([1], [2, 3]) == [2, 3]
  ex longest([1, 2], [3, 4]) == [1, 2]
  if a.len() >= b.len()
    a
  else
    b
